Definition: a resident; by extension, a fellow-citizen
BiblicalUsage: The neighbour is the one who lives next door, and the Bible makes the neighbour a test of character. Israel borrowed jewels of silver and gold from her neighbours on the night of the exodus, the women neighbours named Naomi's grandson Obed, and the psalmist laments that Israel became a reproach to their neighbours.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God put neighbours next door on purpose, so that love would have somewhere to go.
